import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path

table = pd.read_csv("table.csv")
print(table.to_string(index=False))
path = Path("chart.py")
source = path.read_text()
old = "df = pd.DataFrame(data)\n"
new = """df = pd.DataFrame(data)
access_rates = pd.read_csv('table.csv').set_index('Year')
df['ElectricityAccessRate'] = [
    access_rates.loc[year, region]
    for year, region in zip(df['Year'], df['Region'])
]
"""
assert source.count(old) == 1
path.write_text(source.replace(old, new))
exec(compile(path.read_text(), str(path), "exec"))

ax = plt.gca()
print("Title:", ax.get_title())
print("Y limits:", ax.get_ylim())
print("Legend:", [t.get_text() for t in ax.get_legend().get_texts()])
for line, region in zip(ax.lines[:6], table.columns[1:]):
    expected = table[region].to_numpy()
    assert (line.get_ydata() == expected).all(), region
    print(region, list(line.get_ydata()), "color:", line.get_color(), "marker:", line.get_marker())

assert Path("output.png").is_file()
print("Finished: chart.py repaired and output.png saved.")
